name: Bug report
about: Create a report to help us improve
title: ''
labels: bug

---

**Description**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is. Please include:
- What you were trying to do
- What happened instead
- Any error messages or unexpected behavior

**Reproduction**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. List the exact steps needed to reproduce the issue
2. Include any relevant code snippets or commands
3. Describe what happens at each step
4. Note the expected vs actual outcome

**Environment**
- OS: [e.g. Windows 10, macOS 12.3]
- Aide version: [e.g. 0.1.0]
- Aide commit: [commit hash if building from source]
- Editor: [e.g. VS Code 1.70.0]
- Any relevant extensions or configurations

**Additional context**
Add any other context about the problem here, such as:
- Screenshots if applicable
- Related issues
- Workarounds attempted

**Issue Tracker**
Please check if this issue has already been reported at:
https://github.com/codestoryai/aide/issues
